The Story

Built by people who actually build.

Jen spent 7 years in homebuilding and general contracting — managing our Colorado build, then consulting for a major builder. Cody brought 15+ years of enterprise resilience. Together we turned three shipping containers and a piece of raw land into a home designed for efficiency, durability, and adaptability.

It isn't off-grid — it's better. Municipal water, septic, and power, paired with resilience principles and real comfort. No generator drama. Just smart design. Now we're opening it up: to stay in, to learn from, to experience.

How It's Built

Design Principles

Every system reflects our approach to resilience, sustainability, and intentional living.

Tiny

Efficient, purposeful living. No wasted space. Maximum comfort in minimal footprint.

Sustainable

Grid-connected with resilience principles built in. Designed for durability and adaptability.

Simple

Straightforward systems. No unnecessary complexity. Easy to maintain and understand.

Mobile

The 20-foot container sits on a trailer. Built for flexibility, travel, and exploration.
